title: Control Plane ApprovalRecord (immutable ledger record)
description: One immutable record of the append-only approval ledger (S2-2/S2-3). It binds the decision to the exact ConfigurationVersion digest, the analysed ProposalVersion digest and the warnings that were explicitly acknowledged. There is no update or delete form: a written record is final, an undo is a new record with decision 'revoked', and effectiveness is always derived (never stored). The control-plane approval authorizes composition only; the Platform Manifest lifecycle remains the sole publication authority.

configuration_ref.description: The exact configuration digest this approval authorizes; any technical change produces a new digest and therefore requires a new approval.

requirements_ref.description: Duplicated from the analysed proposal for tamper cross-checking; it is never an authority of its own.

acknowledged_findings.description: Exactly the warning finding ids of the analysed proposal, sorted: a warning cannot proceed unacknowledged, an error can never be acknowledged, and info needs none.

authority_ref.description: RBAC attachment point. No authorization policy is implemented in this slice, so it must be null.

revokes.description: Required exactly when decision is 'revoked': the record being revoked. The revoked record itself is never modified.

predecessor.description: Append-only ledger chain: the record must declare the current ledger head.
